patches.purpose: Backport native ARM64 build-host detection for required runtime cross-components.
Honor explicit portable runtime builds while retaining nonportable adapter defaults.
Honor explicit portable ASP.NET builds and avoid duplicate implicit runtime packages.
Use the pinned externals commit timestamp for valid, deterministic IdentityModel metadata without changing assembly or package API versions.

build.sharedComponents: Both Microsoft.NETCore.App 7.0.20 and Microsoft.AspNetCore.App 7.0.20 were built locally. Successful installer DownloadFile tasks copied local archives; captured destination hashes match the local feed. All 184 core-runtime and 138 ASP.NET shared-framework entries in the final SDK match those archives.

construction.note: Local shared-framework origins are verified for SDK SHA-256 e1a84338e21cb061e0d12ef3331f00e18c0a38fd4f8f72dcf428ee548dd34249 in reports/construction/origin-evidence.json. Proof combines completed local-copy installer tasks, historical stable destination fingerprints, local archive/feed hashes and final SDK byte comparisons, with pinned generated component identities and all four patches. The legacy build still uses an upstream bootstrap SDK, previously source-built artifacts, official bootstrap package substitutions, reference packages and other inputs, and runs online; this does not establish an entirely prebuilt-free build.
